<U+0010><U+0002>봆<U+0000>Our setting is a mansion deep in the mountains

<U+0010><U+0002>Ă<U+0002>.<U+0010><U+0002>ĔƵ

certain treasure.<U+0010><U+0002>ĔƵ

The first of the guests is a Trainer by the name of
<U+0010><U+0002>Ă<U+0003>.<U+0010><U+0002>ĔƵ

ever present, seeing to all the guests’ needs.<U+0010><U+0002>ĔƵ

One evening, the guests are all called together to
a very special room of the mansion.<U+0010><U+0002>ĔƵ

This room serves as a giant safe, so fortified that
the move Rage Fist would not crack its defenses.<U+0010><U+0001>븀
So explains the butler, <U+0010><U+0002>Ƌ<U+0001>.<U+0010><U+0002>ĔƵ

In the safe’s center, lovingly displayed in pride of
place, shines the grandiose jewel known only as...<U+0010><U+0001>븀
“<U+0010><U+0002>Ă<U+0006>’s Tear.”<U+0010><U+0002>ĔƵ

This mythical treasure is rumored to have been a
gift from the former king of the land, AZ.<U+0010><U+0001>븁
The mansion’s owner gazes upon it regularly—
every morn and eve—to sustain their spirits.<U+0010><U+0002>ĔƵ

The sun has barely risen the morning after this
showing...when a terrible howl echoes through<U+0010><U+0001>븀
<U+0010><U+0002>Ă<U+0002>’s mansion.<U+0010><U+0002>ĔƵ

The guests gather in front of the safe room that
contained the treasure, drawn by the awful noise.<U+0010><U+0001>븁
And there the millionaire cries out, “My treasure
has been stolen!”<U+0010><U+0002>ĔƵ
“One of my guests must have done it!”<U+0010><U+0002>ĔƵ

you to work out?<U+0010><U+0002>ĔƵ

Haha! How typical of you to have seen right
through all my tricks, my masterful muse!<U+0010><U+0002>ĔƵ

The evil Trainer had left one of their Pokémon in
the room to wait until everyone was gone so it<U+0010><U+0001>븀
could steal the treasure for its master!<U+0010><U+0001>븁
When everyone began to gather at the room the
next morning, this larcenous lout quietly called<U+0010><U+0001>븀

both it and the treasure to cover their tracks!<U+0010><U+0002>ĔƵ

Wonderful, isn’t it? Such a bold and elaborate
setup, worthy of a criminal genius!<U+0010><U+0002>ĔƵ
It’s a masterpiece!
Isn’t it a bit obvious?

Hmm. Now that I think about it, I wonder if I
somehow overlooked a weakness in my airtight<U+0010><U+0001>븀
plot? That would be disappointing.<U+0010><U+0002>ĔƵ

Yet it’s all thanks to your tireless support that
I’ve been able to craft such creative novels.<U+0010><U+0001>븁
You must be my greatest fan, willing to go so far
above and beyond to support my writing career!<U+0010><U+0002>ĔƵ

To show my gratitude, I’d be happy to remix any
of my tales for you, featuring whatever different<U+0010><U+0001>븀

Just come speak to me whenever you’re ready to
